contact.name: Bakyt Zholchubekovich Beshimov
contact.evidence_quote: Formalizing the aim of fostering socio-economic and cultural advancement in Southern Kyrgyzstan, the establishment of Osh State University took place on June 17, 1992. This significant step was taken through a Presidential Decree of the Kyrgyz Republic, building upon the foundation of the Osh State Pedagogical Institute. Mr. Bakyt Zholchubekovich Beshimov assumed the role of Rector, leading the university from its inception until 1998, during a tenure marked by dedicated service and leadership.
